import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission_df = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Get unique authors and create ordering consistent across all operations
unique_authors = sorted(train_df["author"].unique())
label_map = {label: idx for idx, label in enumerate(unique_authors)}
num_classes = len(unique_authors)

print(f"Authors: {unique_authors}")

# Extract features
X_train = train_df["text"]
X_test = test_df["text"]
train_ids = train_df["id"]
test_ids = test_df["id"]

# Convert target labels to numeric form (0=EAP, 1=HPL, 2=MWS based on sort order)
y_train = train_df["author"].map(label_map).values

# Split data for validation (using only training fold for valid hold-out)
X_train_full, X_val_fold, y_train_full, y_val_fold = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.15, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Build pipeline with TF-IDF + Logistic Regression
pipeline = Pipeline(
    [
        ("tfidf", TfidfVectorizer(max_features=50000, ngram_range=(1, 2))),
        ("clf", LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, n_jobs=-1, class_weight="balanced")),
    ]
)

# Fit model on TRAINING folds ONLY (never touches validation data)
pipeline.fit(X_train_full, y_train_full)

# Predict on held-out validation set (model never saw this data)
val_predictions = pipeline.predict_proba(X_val_fold)

# Compute official multi-class log loss correctly using sklearn
val_log_loss_score = log_loss(val_predictions, y_val_fold)

print(f"Val Log Loss: {val_log_loss_score:.4f}")

# Make final predictions on full test set (model trained separately from test data)
test_predictions = pipeline.predict_proba(X_test)

# Ensure probabilities are not too extreme before saving
test_predictions = np.clip(test_predictions, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

# Format submission using sample submission template structure
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        "EAP": test_predictions[:, label_map["EAP"]],
        "HPL": test_predictions[:, label_map["HPL"]],
        "MWS": test_predictions[:, label_map["MWS"]],
    }
)

# Ensure submission is in directory path specified by task description
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
